apiKey.title: Application Key (Client ID)
apiKey.description: Husqvarna Developer Portal Application Key (used as X-Api-Key and OAuth2 client_id).

apiSecret.title: Application Secret (Client Secret)
apiSecret.description: Husqvarna Developer Portal Application Secret (OAuth2 client_secret).

locationId.title: Location ID (optional)
locationId.description: Specific Gardena location ID to use. If empty the first location returned by the API is used.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.
